name: Right click on epic should show context menu to edit/delete
description: Right now if you right click on a board you get a context menu to edit/delete the board. We should have the same for epics.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Complexity 2/10. Branch codex/row-22-epic-context-menu, based on origin/main a27bcde. The Epics screen already has a context menu; the missing menu is in the Epics sidebar. Plan: add optional Plugin Sidebar edit/delete links using the existing Epic form and delete confirmation, update docs, capture before/after evidence, and run typecheck, lint, unit and CLI checks.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/104 adds Epic sidebar Edit/Delete menus and matching keys. Typecheck, lint, 66 unit tests, 20 CLI tests and build passed; manual TUI checks passed. Four screenshots uploaded and verified. Validation signed off at 40ad56a. Manual checks canceled edits/deletion; no Board data changed.
